profile_source.literal:
A coefficient list \([c_0,\ldots,c_k]\) means
\(\sum_{j=0}^k c_j/L^j\). Write \(M_j=\sum_{i=0}^{j}g_i/L^i\) for
the exact true Li coefficients in `orders.md`.
